jobs.description:

At USAA, our mission is to empower our members to achieve financial security through highly competitive products, exceptional service and trusted advice. We seek to be the #1 choice for the military community and their families.

Embrace a fulfilling career at USAA, where our core values – honesty, integrity, loyalty and service – define how we treat each other and our members. Be part of what truly makes us special and impactful.

We are proud to support active-duty military spouses. USAA roles may offer remote or hybrid flexibility for active-duty military spouses consistent with applicable policy and business needs.

The Opportunity

As a dedicated Strategy Consultant I, you will be responsible for providing strategic support for a LOB/staff business area. You will work collaboratively with strategy and business teams to support internal consulting projects in the areas of strategy development, growth strategy, organizational design and operating model and business transformation

We offer a flexible work environment that requires an individual to be in the office 4 days per week. This position can be based in one of the following locations: San Antonio, TX, Plano, TX, or Charlotte, NC.

Relocation assistance is not available for this position.

What you'll do:
- Support internal consulting projects: Understand the strategic opportunities and issues faced by the organization. Design workplans, conduct targeted research, and collect data from various internal and external sources. Perform high-impact analysis, aiding in evaluating and designing business solutions. Support the creation of compelling storylines that clearly articulate findings, insights, and recommendations.
- Monitor and assess external trends: Conduct industry and competitive research to identify potential strategic opportunities and threats. Communicate insights and support the development of recommendations to leadership.
- Support strategic and operational  planning: Support the development and communication of the organization’s plan.
- Assist with strategy communication and alignment: Contribute to communicating the organization’s strategy to senior management, employees, and other stakeholders to ensure that all levels of the organization are aligned with and working towards the same goals. Work collaboratively with broader strategy team to support the design, development, and facilitation of strategy offsites.
- Monitor and report on progress: Assist with monitoring the progress of the organization’s strategic initiatives and reporting on results to senior management and other stakeholders.
- Ensure risks associated with business activities are effectively identified, measured, monitored, and controlled in accordance with risk and compliance policies and procedures.

What you have:
- Bachelor's Degree in a Business, Engineering or Science discipline; OR 4 years of related experience (in addition to the minimum years of experience required) may be substituted in lieu of degree.
- 4 years of business experience demonstrating proficiency in strategy consulting, corporate or business unit strategy or relevant work experience; or an Advanced Degree in Business or STEM and 2 years business experience demonstrating proficiency in strategy consulting, corporate or business unit strategy or relevant work experience. Military experience may be considered relevant experience for this role.
- Demonstrated ability to analyze complex problems and contribute to the development of clear, actionable strategic recommendations.
- Solid communication and presentation skills, with advanced proficiency in tools like PowerPoint and Excel, for effectively analyzing problems and sharing ideas.
- Proficient knowledge in project management.
- Experience in influencing business decisions.

What sets you apart:
- Military veterans are encouraged to apply; your leadership, problem-solving, and adaptability skills are highly valued.
- Experience in Property & Casualty (P&C) insurance, life insurance, or retail banking is helpful, but not required.
- An MBA is preferred, but not required; a strong academic record in business, economics, engineering, or a quantitative discipline is a plus.
- Ability to perform well in fast-paced environments and manage multiple project demands.

Compensation range: The salary range for this position is: $93,770 - $128,900 .

jobs.title: Executive Director, Risk Management - Life Insurance
jobs.description:
Why USAA?
At USAA, our mission is to empower our members to achieve financial security through highly competitive products, exceptional service and trusted advice. We seek to be the #1 choice for the military community and their families.

Embrace a fulfilling career at USAA, where our core values – honesty, integrity, loyalty and service – define how we treat each other and our members. Be part of what truly makes us special and impactful.

We are proud to support active-duty military spouses. USAA roles may offer remote or hybrid flexibility for active-duty military spouses consistent with applicable policy and business needs.

The Opportunity

Reporting directly to the VP and Chief Risk Officer of USAA Life Insurance Company (LifeCo), the Executive Director, Risk Management will lead several of the organization's most strategic risk functions, serving as a key member of the LifeCo Risk Leadership Team and helping define a modern, business-aligned risk management framework that supports innovation while ensuring the safety and soundness of the Life Insurance business.   The Executive Director will provide leadership across Risk Programs, Operational Risk Management, and Model Risk Management, while also overseeing an emerging and highly visible Data & AI Risk function. As LifeCo expands its use of advanced analytics, artificial intelligence, and enterprise data capabilities, this leader will play a critical role in establishing practical, appropriately calibrated governance for AI models, data quality, and emerging technology risks. Working closely with first-line business leaders, the Executive Director will help determine where controls should be strengthened, where processes can be simplified, and how risk oversight can enable responsible innovation without impeding business objectives.

A central mandate of the position will be simplifying and tailoring the LifeCo risk framework. The Executive Director will help modernize and streamline risk programs, operational risk processes, and model risk governance to create a more efficient, scalable, and sustainable operating model. This individual will possess the judgment to distinguish between minimum viable controls and best-in-class practices, ensuring that governance remains rigorous while appropriately sized for the organization's risk profile, strategic objectives, and pace of innovation.

This is a unique opportunity to help shape the future of risk management for USAA's Life Insurance Company during a period of significant growth, transformation, and modernization.    This role is ideally suited for a seasoned life insurance risk executive who combines deep Life Insurance expertise with experience across operational risk, model risk management, enterprise risk management, data governance, and regulatory oversight. The Executive Director will serve as a trusted advisor to senior leadership, influence enterprise-wide priorities, and help establish USAA's long-term approach to AI governance, data quality oversight, and risk management modernization within the Life Insurance business. In doing so, this leader will have the opportunity to build and mature critical capabilities, develop high-performing teams, and leave a lasting impact on the future direction of risk management across LifeCo.

Location
- USAA offers a flexible work environment that requires an individual to be   in the office 4 days per week.   This position can be based in one of the following locations: Plano, TX (strong preference); San Antonio, TX; Charlotte, NC. Relocation assistance   is   available for this position.

What You'll Do
- Engage in senior leaders' strategy discussions, real-time evaluations of risks, and effective challenge to ensure safety and soundness of the business and accomplishment of objectives.

- Establish a best-in-class Risk Management framework to ensure comprehensive oversight and management of risks across the full risk taxonomy.

- Ensure the risk aligns within appetites tolerances and strategic goals, product plans, forecasts, and adjusts to variances.

- Lead a team of employees dedicated to managing risk in alignment with a strong effective risk governance and oversight.

- Set the agenda, build diverse high-performing teams, and sell the vision.

- Ensure training and coaching of employees and provides the team with development opportunities.

- Maintain a long-term view of how risk systems should be adapted and integrated to maximize the ability to manage risk in an environment shaped by regulatory change and disruptive, emerging technologies.

- • Ensure effective and appropriate policies, procedures, and controls are in place supporting all risk processes, systems, strategies, and implementations.

- Establish trust and rapport with senior business leaders to sustain oversight of the second line risk role.

- Partner with the senior risk executives in managing overall risk appetite to include the identification and definition of key methods, metrics, and limits.

- Partner across Risk Management, Finance, and the business while effectively challenging variances to plan and strategies to mitigate.

- Provide advice to other key business partners and drive key decisions assessing risk and reward through effective challenge.

- Actively engage line of business leaders to ensure all risks are appropriately addressed consistent with policy and the Risk Appetite.

- Liaise with Compliance and CLO on legal & regulatory considerations that impact business operations and product offerings in accordance with federal and state regulations.

- Liaise with Compliance and CLO to influence sound governance structure for oversight of risks and business operations.

What You Have
- Bachelors degree, or 4 years of relevant education and/or experience.

- 10 or more years of related business/risk experience developing strategies, managing major initiatives and delivering results in a large financial institution or professional business services environment.

- 4 years of people leadership experience in building, managing and/or developing high-performing teams.

- Experience implementing an enterprise-wide risk management program that adheres to regulatory requirements and expectations.

- Significant knowledge of risk frameworks including risk governance; risk appetite; process, risk and control analysis; control effectiveness measurement; risk management coverage plan (monitoring, assessment and testing).

- Demonstrated ability to influence at senior levels within an organization.

- Proven capability to communicate effectively across the 1st and 2nd Lines of Defense and build collaborative relationships.

- Strong written and oral communication skills, including the ability to communicate complex analyses to a non-technical audience.

- Strong problem-solving, critical thinking and analytical skills.

- Deep knowledge of the life insurance regulatory environment, including state insurance regulations, NAIC risk management and solvency frameworks (including ORSA), statutory accounting principles, capital and reserve requirements, model risk governance, product and underwriting risk oversight, third-party risk management, operational resilience, and applicable federal laws, regulations, and supervisory guidance impacting life insurance carriers and their affiliated financial services operations.

What Sets You Apart
- Deep Life Insurance risk management expertise with a proven track record overseeing complex risk frameworks within a life insurer. Strong understanding of the industry's unique risk profile, including product, actuarial, capital, reserve, investment, liquidity, operational, and regulatory risks, coupled with the ability to balance business growth, customer outcomes, and prudent risk-taking.

- Significant leadership experience across both Operational Risk Management and Model Risk Management , including the design, enhancement, and oversight of risk governance frameworks, risk assessments, control environments, model inventories, validation programs, and monitoring processes that strengthen oversight while remaining practical and business-focused.

- Demonstrated experience governing emerging technologies, advanced analytics, data quality, and artificial intelligence risks. Strong understanding of the opportunities and risks associated with AI-enabled business capabilities, along with the ability to establish appropriately calibrated governance, testing, monitoring, and oversight frameworks that support innovation while maintaining effective risk management.

- Track record of modernizing, simplifying, and transforming risk management programs by reducing unnecessary complexity, improving operating efficiency, and tailoring governance requirements to an organization's risk profile. Ability to distinguish between minimum viable controls and best-in-class practices while implementing solutions that are both effective and scalable.

- Strategic leadership and executive influence skills with the ability to translate complex risk concepts into actionable business insights, effectively challenge senior stakeholders, drive alignment across first- and second-line organizations, and enable sound risk-informed decision-making in a rapidly evolving business and regulatory environment.

Visa Sponsorship
